features.text: Soft foam construction for comfortable, reliable neck support
Easy to put on and adjust for different neck sizes
Multiple size options ensure a proper fit
Lightweight design for comfortable extended wear
Simple but effective support for various neck conditions

measurement: To find your perfect size, measure around your neck and from your jaw to your collarbone. Visit our Perfect Fit Promise page where you can ensure a proper fit with the help of our experienced medical team.
